name: input
title: Radial Glow Input
description: A dark sign-up card with two labelled text fields. Hovering a field lights a soft blue radial glow under the cursor that trails as it moves, and focusing adds a thin ring for typing.
use: A dark sign-up or login form where small feedback makes plain text fields feel responsive.
avoid: Touch and keyboard use: the glow only follows a mouse pointer.
a11y: The glow follows a mouse only and reduced-motion is not considered; labels and ids must be supplied by the caller. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark sign-up card with the bold title Welcome to StashUI, a grey subtitle and two labelled fields stacked vertically. Each field is a rounded slate bar with faint placeholder text, and the hovered one carries a small blue glow under the cursor.
behaves: Moving the pointer over a field lights a blue radial glow that follows the cursor and fades at the edges; leaving removes it. Focusing a field adds a thin grey ring and a caret for typing.
customise: Any native input attributes pass through alongside className; the glow radius, blue colour and ring styles are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One motion template glow on a single input; nothing loops.
